items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Jane Jarvis is the pianist yes. Oh, she’s crazy about that group.

ctx.x: We had occasion to see a group in Los Angeles called the Statesmen of Jazz. I think they’re coming to New York pretty soon. It’s a nice idea that they’re trying to promote, that you have to be over 65 to be in the group.
Jane Jarvis is the pianist yes. Oh, she’s crazy about that group.
And one of the things that they try to do, every time they play a concert is during that day they go into a school.
